integrity: Self-contained analytical proof; finite symbolic/numerical tests are supplementary, not an infinite proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact analysis applies to the squared-odds Rayleigh generator, Weibull baseline, unit discrete time; not the unequal-power or arbitrary-exponent generated-G families. The threshold equations are implicit; priority over unindexed work is not conclusively established.
title: Exact hazard reversal thresholds for the discrete Rayleigh–Weibull lifetime law
